about: Shared parity vectors for provider routing score/choose (contract §4-§5). Both the API (scripts/test-provider-routing-10486.py) and the Center must produce exactly these outputs (floats compared with relative tolerance 1e-9 after rounding to 9 decimals; scores in 'choose' are not compared).

rules.aggregate_defaults: Any count/sum field missing from an input aggregate is 0; lat_hist missing is [0]*8.
rules.lat_hist: 8 counts for upper bounds [1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128] seconds; latency s goes to the first bound with s <= bound, anything above 64 s goes to the last bucket. median_ms = 1000 * bound of the first bucket whose cumulative count * 2 >= total; total 0 -> null.
rules.cost: USD per 1K tokens. cost_n>=5 and in_tok+out_tok>0: cost_usd/((in_tok+out_tok)/1000). Else listed prices (USD per token): c=cached_tok/in_tok (0 if in_tok=0), eff_in=prompt*(1-c)+cache_read*c (cache_read null -> prompt), 1000*(in*eff_in+out*completion)/(in+out); without tokens 1000*(eff_in+completion)/2. prompt or completion missing -> null.
rules.factors: costfactor = cheapest/cost, latfactor = fastest/median over candidates with a known positive value; unknown -> 1.
rules.learning: n < min_samples (default 20): score = median of the non-learning candidates' scores (mean of the two middle for an even count); none -> null.
rules.choose_steps: 1 remove blocked; 2 no_fp4: remove fp4/int4 unless every listed candidate (before step 1) is fp4/int4 (unknown counts as not fp4); 3 avoid: remove avoid hosts unless that removes every remaining candidate (with no candidates at all the avoid hosts still count); ignore = sorted(blocked + hosts removed by no_fp4 + applied avoid hosts) so an OpenRouter fallback cannot reach them; 4 mode order: manual = manual_order ∩ candidates (+ auto order of the rest when manual_fallback, else only=true), reason manual; auto = auto order, reason auto; stats with <2 candidates having n>=min_samples = auto order with reason learning; stats otherwise: rank by score desc then host asc, pool = non-cooled ranked hosts (all if every host is cooled), u1=rng(); if u1<explore and pool has others: u2=rng(), pick among pool[1:] with probability ∝ score (walk cumulative in rank order, first with u2*total < cumulative; total 0 -> first), reason explore; else chosen=pool[0], reason best, or fallback_cooldown when the top-ranked host is cooled; order = [chosen] + rest of pool + cooled by rank. For auto/manual/learning cooled hosts are moved to the end (stable) and reason becomes fallback_cooldown if that changed the first host. 5 pinned host (present and not cooled) first, reason pinned; else sticky host (present and not cooled) first, reason sticky. 6 order truncated to 16.
rules.auto_order: cache-capable (cache_read < prompt) by cache_read+completion asc, then others with prompt+completion by that sum asc, then hosts without prices by name; ties by host
